tools.name: search
tools.description: Find Medicare findings (one sourced number each) and datasets by words: a subject, a measure, a state. Returns ids to pass to fetch. Example: "Medicare Advantage plans ending Texas", "star ratings by state", "Part D premium".

tools.name: fetch
tools.description: The full text of one search result: the number in a sentence with its place, period and source, the method, the known limits, the page and the credit line.

tools.name: list_findings
tools.description: Every finding with its headline number, or the findings that have a version for one state.

tools.name: get_finding
tools.description: One finding as data: number, statement, source files, date retrieved, method, limits, credit line, CSV. Give a state for the state version.

tools.name: list_datasets
tools.description: The datasets in the data library with their files, columns and row counts. Filter by words or kind.

tools.name: query_dataset
tools.description: Rows of one CSV file from the data library, filtered by column values. Use list_datasets to get a file path and its columns. Returns at most 200 rows a call; use offset for more.

tools.name: get_ma_share_index
tools.description: The monthly index: the share of people eligible for Medicare who are in Medicare Advantage plans (CMS enrollment files). Without arguments: the latest edition, every state. With a state: that state's monthly series. With an edition (YYYY-MM): that month.

tools.name: how_to_cite
tools.description: The credit line, the reference and the usage terms for a finding or a dataset.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
